mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, batch_no, export_rows, file_path, sftp_status, execute_status, error_msg, DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as start_time, DATE_FORMAT(end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as end_time, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time FROM b_data_export_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
